purpose: Two named arrangement populations. The reservation is the file; the rule is in the file.
rule: The reserved set never informs lr0, the rank grid, or the stopping criterion.
rule_enforced_by: tests/test_reserved_arrangements.py (lr0 / grid / stopping provenance, not string presence of reserved ids in new-axis pre-commits)

old.name: old arrangements
old.purpose: LR comparator: corrected versus quadratic, to choose the primary law. Not a not-tuned report.
old.keying_detail: On the registered grid, make_stream consumed paired_init(seed)['stream']; stream_id was stored and unread. Unique arrangements are init seeds 0-7. Reproducing them requires arrangement_source='legacy_seed', not stream_rng.

reserved.name: reserved arrangements
reserved.purpose: Every new axis, plus a duplicate of the headline measurement under the primary law as the not-tuned report.
reserved.keying_detail: pipeline.stream_rng(stream_id). Init seed is a separate factor (paired_init). Unique n=8 arrangements are these eight stream_ids.
reserved.block_reason: Ids 0-7 appear on disk as stored labels (unread on the registered grid) and as genuine-n keys after the RNG fix. This block is above every used id.

not_design_decision: New-axis pre-commits that name the reserved population as experimental subjects. That is the intended use. Provenance of lr0, the rank grid, and stopping is asserted directly.
Per-arm result records whose stream_id is the experimental unit after the law, rank grid, and stopping criterion are already fixed.
The not-tuned duplicate under the primary law, which is the point of the reserved set.
